messages:
Maria: Heads-up — nightly billing run had a cluster of card declines (28 total). Gateway shows mixed failure codes: 6 marked `do_not_retry`, rest are `insufficient_funds` or `issuer_decline`. Planning a consolidated retry sweep + customer notice. Any red flags?

billing-bot: Automated report attached: invoices [INV-8821, INV-8822, INV-8827, INV-8830, INV-8840, ...] (28). Total MRR at risk: $42,300. Gateway codes: do_not_retry(6), insufficient_funds(15), issuer_decline(7).

Alex: For soft declines (`insufficient_funds`, `issuer_decline`) we can do 3 retries over 48h with exponential backoff. Suggested schedule: now + 6h + 24h. For `do_not_retry` we should not auto-retry — send card update flow + 1st manual follow-up.

Raj: +1 to that. Also: for invoices > $5k (4 customers) suggest putting a 48h hold and surface wire option in the notice instead of auto-retry — avoids churn from repeated card attempts and reduces failed-charge disputes. One of them (PeakHealth) already has pending wire instructions but finance hasn't confirmed bank details yet.

Jamie: I can draft the customer-facing message. Proposed copy snippet: ```Hi <Customer>, we attempted to process invoice <INV-XXXX> and it was declined. We will attempt one more time automatically. If you'd prefer to pay by wire, reply to this email and we'll provide instructions. To update card now, click: <payment-portal-link>.``` Will include link and a note about avoiding service disruption.

Maria: Nice. Operational asks: (1) approval to run the retry sweep for soft declines now, (2) approval to mark `do_not_retry` accounts as manual-collect and trigger card-update email, (3) hold sending auto-retries for the 4 high-value invoices until we confirm wire fallback option. Also need a record of retries for audit.

Nora: Approve the plan with two conditions: (a) add a flag so retries are logged to the invoice history (who/when/response), and (b) any customer > $25k ARR gets a quick Slack ping to the AE before retries.

Alex: Will add logging. CLI to kick off immediate sweep for soft declines (dry-run first):
```
./billing retry --filter "status:declined type:card code:soft" --strategy "6h,24h,48h" --notify true --dry-run
```
After dry-run, remove `--dry-run` to execute.

Maria: I'll hold the 4 high-value invoices and mark PeakHealth as "pending-wire-review". Jamie, please include wire instructions option in the email and add a line: "Reply 'WIRE' to this thread to request instructions" so CS/AEs can pick it up.

Jamie: Will do. I'll post the email template in #customer-ops for AE feedback before send. Short subject: "Action required: Payment attempt failed for your Redwood invoice"

Raj: One more ops note — for ACH setup attempts that are failing (2 customers), switch them to micro-deposit verification and pause recurring debits until verification completes. Save the original attempted setup metadata in the payment method notes.

billing-bot: Recorded action items: retry_sweep_scheduled (soft declines, dry-run), manual_collect_flagged (6 accounts), hold_for_wire (4 invoices), ach-microdeposit (2 customers). Ticket: FIN-4537 created.

Nora: Thanks. Execute sweep after dry-run results look good. If dry-run shows >10% failure bounce back or gateway rate-limit warnings, pause and escalate to payments infra. Otherwise proceed and send customer notices after first retry attempt. :white_check_mark:

Maria: Copy. I'll run the dry-run now and post results in 15m.

Alex: ping me if dry-run shows any weird gateway errors — will stand by.

Jamie: Draft ready, will share in 10.

Maria: Dry-run summary: 22 soft declines included, expected success on second attempt ~45% per historical trend. No rate-limit warnings. Proceeding to execute live sweep now. I'll attach the audit export afterwards.

Nora: Approved to proceed. Keep finance looped and tag me for any exceptions.

Maria: Sweep executed at 1832005532. Live retries initiated. Audit export posted to FIN/collections/Sweeps/1832005432.csv. Closing thread here and tracking in FIN-4537.
